scope: Implement one bounded persistent-shared-outpost product slice on the accepted P5 lineage over the accepted Edge Gateway Foundation: two clients share one persistent outpost through the gateway transport stack; the mine -> inventory/container -> equipment/tool -> real-resource build loop persists to the single existing persistence owner; server restart reconstructs the canonical outpost; player reconnect restores inventory, equipment and construction; five clean end-to-end repeats and a bounded soak prove stability. No new network authority, no second persistence owner, no private item graph.
required_outputs: Persistent shared outpost state bound to the single existing persistence owner
Two-client shared outpost gameplay through the gateway transport stack
Server restart reconstructs the canonical outpost
Player reconnect restores inventory, equipment and construction
Five clean end-to-end repeats with stable identities and OperationId continuity
Fresh evidence map, Reviewer PASS and Verifier PASS before P6 checkpoint proposal
stop_conditions: A second persistence owner or private P6 save format would be required
A second Item Graph or private construction truth would be required
A network protocol, authority, prediction or reconciliation foundation change would be required; fail closed to NX/foundation decision
The exact accepted P5 predecessor base cannot be proven
Production mutation escapes the bounded persistent-outpost scope
risk_reasons: Mutates authoritative persistence and canonical outpost gameplay state
Composes persistence, replication, reconnect recovery and construction
Must prevent duplicate canonical outpost truth or identity drift after restart/reconnect

design_brief.problem_statement: The accepted P5 lineage can equip tools and mine canonically, and the accepted Edge Gateway Foundation transports clients through the gateway, but no persistent playable outpost survives server restart or player reconnect as shared canonical state.
design_brief.current_behavior: Outpost-relevant state lives in volatile runtime structures; restart loses the world and reconnect reconstructs only partially from per-system recovery paths.
design_brief.desired_behavior: A persistent shared outpost whose canonical state is owned by the single existing persistence owner, reconstructed deterministically on server restart, restored per-player on reconnect, and played by two clients through the gateway transport stack without duplicate truth.
design_brief.selected_design: Bind the existing single persistence owner to the canonical outpost composition over the accepted P5 lineage and the accepted gateway foundation transport/session stack; reconstruct on start from that owner; keep all client traffic on the gateway path proven by EG1-EG5.
expected_risks: Duplicate canonical outpost truth between persistence and runtime
Persistence writes escaping the bounded outpost scope
validation_plan: Freeze persistence ownership boundary before implementation
Two-client shared outpost proof through the gateway
Restart/reconstruct and reconnect/restore proofs with checksums
Full world regression, post-build critique, independent review and verification
design_brief.why_selected: It adds the persistence capability while preserving one persistence owner, one item graph and the gateway-only client topology accepted by the foundation.
